name: Contortion of Cúchulainn
text: Contortion of Cúchulainn names the battle frenzy of the Ulster hero Cúchulainn. Irish texts call the state riastrad. In combat his body twists in a strange way, and the full account sits in the main article on Cúchulainn, under riastrad.

attributes.attribute: English rendering of the battle frenzy riastrad
Ulster hero whose body twists in combat

okr.objective: Route readers to the riastrad discussion in the Cúchulainn article.
key_results: Identify the Contortion of Cúchulainn as the hero's battle frenzy.
Give the Irish term riastrad for the state.
Point readers to the main article on Cúchulainn.
